latest.headline: Chip selloff deepens; MU indicated about 5% lower, near 200-day average
latest.tldr: Asian memory stocks crashed for a second day, Qualcomm's weak guidance and a Bloomberg report that Micron paused its new Taiwan plant add to the pressure, and with Nasdaq 100 futures down about 1% and SMH down 3.7% at about 9:10 ET, MU (about $755) and SOX (about 9,900 implied) are set to open at fresh lows while the Dow keeps rallying.
